labelled: 2026-11-12, by hand (Claude Opus 5.5) against the spec's node and relationship definitions in spec/dist, before the extraction was run on the corpus; CBM 0.12.1 index of full-stack-fastapi-template
policy: Every CBM Table, Resource, Image, Chart and Process node gets a label: the DR element type a modeller of this repository would give the thing it names, or none.
Things declared more than once are one element: a compose service in compose.yml, compose.override.yml and compose.deploy.yml is one node. The element key is layer.type|<CBM name>.

Images used only by development or test tooling (a dev container, a local mail catcher, a browser-test runner) are not part of the system: none. Images the build consumes (base images, COPY --from sources) and images the system runs are artifacts.
Gold relationships are those a modeller would draw between the gold elements that the relationship catalog allows, whether or not a CBM edge carries them; 'edge' says which CBM edge could.
